name: Brew & Bloom
description: A neighborhood cafe serving freshly brewed coffee, handcrafted treats, and cozy moments. The cafe focuses on carefully selected coffee beans and freshly baked treats.
special_offer: The website advertises 20% off a coffee and dessert combo. The offer is described on the site as a current special; additional terms are not specified.
ordering: Customers can browse the menu and place an order through the website API. Online checkout uses Stripe test mode in this local development setup.
payment: Online checkout is provided through Stripe in test mode for local development. Do not enter real payment details.
